subject: Recap: Redwood demo + dedicated/VPC options

Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Recap: Redwood demo + dedicated/VPC options

Thanks again for taking the time today, Alex — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Problem we heard: Acme wants consistent low-latency inference for customer-facing features while meeting strict data residency & audit requirements for payments data.
- Recommended path: start with a short hosted POC to validate integration, then move to Redwood Dedicated (reserved GPU pools) or Redwood Private (VPC / on-prem) for production if you need network isolation & KMS/HSM.

Attachments: redwood-dedicated-options.pdf (pricing & deployment variants) and redwood-sow-template.docx (SOW template) — attached for your procurement/engineering review.

Agreed next steps from today:
1) I’ll share the dedicated vs private brief + SOW (attached).
2) Vivek will be available for a technical follow-up to confirm connectivity requirements for VPC/on-prem.
3) Alex to confirm procurement timeline & whether Acme prefers a hosted POC or go straight to Dedicated/VPC.

Can you confirm which path you want to prioritize and your preferred timing? If Dedicated/VPC is a hard requirement, we’ll schedule a 30-min tech + procurement call next week to review network diagrams and a rough timeline.

Best,
Marissa Cole

marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0198

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear recap and the docs.

Quick answers:
- Compliance & audit are a blocker for us on hosted with customer payment data. We are very interested in Dedicated/VPC or an on-prem option depending on cost and timeline.
- Can you provide a ballpark for a Dedicated monthly commit (GPU count example) and an estimated 8–12 week timeline for a VPC/on-prem rollout? Procurement is looped in (procurement@acme.com).

Also: any gotchas we should know about migration from a hosted POC to Dedicated?

If you can suggest a 30-minute slot next week (Vivek cc'd on Marissa's original) that works for your team, we’ll try to get the right engineering & procurement folks on the call.

Hi Alex — just bumping this thread in case it fell off your queue. Wanted to make it easy to move forward:

- Vivek and I are available next week for a 30-min sync to walk through the redwood-dedicated-options.pdf and the SOW template.
- Quick ballpark: for a Dedicated deployment serving ~200 qps peak (3–4 GPU nodes depending on model choices & quantization), monthly committed pricing typically starts in the mid-six figures — happy to give a more concrete example on the call and show cost tradeoffs between Dedicated vs Private/VPC.
- Timeline: hosted POC can be done in ~2 weeks; Dedicated/VPC production rollout typically 6–12 weeks after scoping and network prep. On-prem tends to add lead time for hardware and network approvals.

If Dedicated/VPC is a hard requirement for compliance, let us know and we’ll prioritize a technical/network call (Vivek will bring the network diagram checklist). Otherwise, if you prefer a fast hosted POC to validate integration, we can get that started immediately.

Proposed times (PST): Tue 2/2 10:30am, Wed 2/3 1:00pm, Thu 2/4 9:00am. Which works for you & procurement?

Thanks,
